gates.name: Data quality
gates.question: Is the sample stream complete and trustworthy?

gates.name: Mode / service
gates.question: Was the loop in automatic long enough to judge?

gates.name: SP activity
gates.question: Did the setpoint move enough to confound the analysis?

gates.name: Operating region
gates.question: Was the loop inside its valid operating band?

gates.name: Base performance
gates.question: How large is the control error?

gates.name: Actuator effort
gates.question: How hard is the actuator working for that error?

gates.name: Oscillation (ACF)
gates.question: Is there a regular oscillation, and at what period?

gates.name: Spectral (FFT)
gates.question: Does the spectrum show a dominant peak and harmonics?

gates.name: Stiction shape
gates.question: Is the OP trace triangular, as stiction produces?

gates.name: Horch oddness
gates.question: Does the cross-correlation show the odd symmetry of stiction?

gates.name: Phase geometry
gates.question: Does the PV-OP phase plot show sharp corners?

gates.name: Valve / saturation
gates.question: Is the actuator saturated or cycling at a limit?

gates.name: Sensor health
gates.question: Is the measurement frozen, quantised or drifting?

gates.name: Step-test evidence
gates.question: Is there an approved step test to support tuning claims?

gates.name: Disturbance context
gates.question: Could an upstream loop be causing this oscillation?

gates.name: VP confirmation
gates.question: Is valve position available to confirm the diagnosis?

gates.name: Diagnosis band
gates.question: How confident is the final verdict?

note: CONFIRMED requires a VP signal; without it G14 caps confidence at 0.89.
